title: Linear push-forward of a compactly supported integer multiplicity current (Simon 6.2.23–2.24 and 3.9)
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (L : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P), 0 < m → R.Represents X → IsCompact X.support → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ Y.support ⊆ L '' X.support ∧ (BoundaryVanishes X → BoundaryVanishes Y) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, Y ω = R.action (affinePullbackForm L 0 (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m))
